paraphrase: No interfering with the device, other apps, networks or services: no self-updating outside Play, no downloading executable code, no exploiting vulnerabilities, no blocking other apps' ads, no cheats, no proxying for third parties unless that is the app's stated purpose, no web views with a JavaScript interface loading untrusted content, no bypassing power management unless eligible, no full-screen intent for disruptive ads. Foreground services in apps targeting Android 14 or later must declare a valid type with its matching permission, be user-initiated or perceptible, stoppable, and run only as long as needed, and be declared in Play Console with a description and video.
quote: Apps that are not eligible for allowlisting and attempt to bypass system power management.
